newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Socialists to form govt Wednesday/Thursday.
newsitem.headline: French Socialists to form govt Wednesday/Thursday.

text.p: France's newly elected Socialist party will form a government on Wednesday or Thursday, Socialist party spokesman Francois Hollande said on Monday.
Asked on French television channel LCI when the government would be named, he said, "Wednesday or Thursday."

President Jacques Chirac earlier called on Socialist leader Lionel Jospin to become France's next prime minister, replacing Alain Juppe, following a defeat for the ruling centre-right coalition in France's parliamentary election on Sunday.
